cohort: 200 pregnant women with a history of previous spontaneous abortions attending the antenatal OPD and labor room at J.L.N Hospital and Research Centre, Bhilai, Chhattisgarh, India.
finding: Previous spontaneous abortion was significantly associated with increased risk of oligohydramnios, preterm delivery, PROM, PPROM, low birth weight, and caesarean section in subsequent pregnancies.
mod_finding: The study found a significantly higher rate of caesarean sections among cases (prior spontaneous abortion) compared to controls (prior full-term live births), including both emergency and elective caesarean sections.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was mentioned as an outcome, but no specific birth weight ranges were given.
